about: Made-up answers for scripts/eval-llm.mjs (0.70.0): six languages, consumer, business, public-sector and local. Every brand is invented. `expect` is what a careful reader would label; `brands` are the names the rules would find, `missed` the ones they would not.

answers.prompt: best phone under $500 in the US
answers.answer: For most people in the US, the **Zento Nova 8** ($449) is the pick: great battery and a clean camera. The Kovo Air 3 ($399) is cheaper but I wouldn't buy it for gaming. If you can stretch, look at the Lumi Pro from Orbix Labs, sold at Shopwell.

answers.prompt: Zento Payroll vs Kovo HR for a 50-person company
answers.answer: Both handle payroll for a 50-person company. Zento Payroll is stronger on compliance in the UK and EU, with automatic HMRC filing. Kovo HR is cheaper at £6 per employee per month but its reporting is basic. Lumi People, owned by Orbix Group, is an alternative if you also need recruiting.

answers.prompt: dentista cerca de mí en Madrid
answers.answer: En el centro de Madrid, **Clínica Sonrisa Zento** tiene buenas reseñas y abre los sábados. Dental Kovo, en Chamberí, es más económica (limpieza desde 45 €). Evita reservar sin presupuesto previo.

Para MEI no Brasil, o **Banco Zento** é a melhor opção: conta gratuita e emissão de boleto sem tarifa. O Kovo Bank cobra R$ 9,90 por mês, mas tem cartão com cashback. Evite o Lumi Pay, que tem muitas reclamações no Reclame Aqui.

answers.prompt: सबसे अच्छा इलेक्ट्रिक स्कूटर 1 लाख के अंदर
answers.answer: 1 लाख रुपये के अंदर ज़ेंटो ई-राइड सबसे अच्छा विकल्प है, इसकी रेंज 120 किमी है। कोवो स्पार्क सस्ता है (₹89,999) लेकिन सर्विस नेटवर्क कमज़ोर है।

answers.prompt: 大学生におすすめのノートパソコン
answers.answer: 大学生には「ゼント エアー14」がおすすめです。軽くてバッテリーが長持ちします（約12万円）。安さ重視ならコヴォブックも候補ですが、画面は暗めです。

answers.prompt: أفضل باقة إنترنت منزلي في دبي
answers.answer: في دبي، باقة زينتو فايبر هي الأفضل للعائلات بسرعة 500 ميغابت مقابل 389 درهم شهرياً. كوفو نت أرخص لكنها أبطأ في أوقات الذروة.

answers.prompt: how to renew a passport online
answers.answer: You can renew online through the national passport office website. You'll need a digital photo and your old passport number; the fee is shown before you pay. Third-party sites like Zento Visa Help charge extra and aren't needed.

answers.prompt: which cloud provider is most secure for healthcare data
answers.answer: For healthcare data, Zento Cloud has HIPAA and ISO 27001 certification and signs a BAA. Kovo Compute is also certified but its audit logs cost extra. Many hospitals pair either with Lumi Shield for encryption key management.

answers.prompt: travailler chez Zento : salaire et avis
answers.answer: Chez Zento, un développeur débutant gagne environ 42 000 € par an à Paris. Les avis sur Kovo Emploi sont positifs sur l'équilibre vie pro-perso, moins sur les promotions.
